lens: Art-directed template builder: Process, About, FAQ, Reviews, Contact
reads: research/cedar-springs-teardown-blueprint.md (moved from the repo root at the seed commit)
deliverables: /process/ with maintenance and installation tracks and deliverables per step + guarantee
/about/ (named owner token, 3–6 people max, credentials row tokens only), /faq/ grouped, /reviews/ (labelled Sample, Google link, no review schema), /contact/ with fallback contact panel
acceptance: A13#34: Lead with 3–6 key people with real bios — verified by e2e/company.spec#about-people
A12#2: Named, phased process with deliverables — verified by e2e/company.spec#process-tracks
A12#4: Real-crew credibility (faces and roles, only when real) — verified by check-honesty#no-stock-people
P2#12: Process page (two tracks), FAQ page, accessibility statement — verified by e2e/company.spec#process-faq-statement
No Review or AggregateRating markup anywhere (check-honesty)
gates: cd $WT/site && node tools/dev-setup.mjs --devtools   # once it exists (W1 build); before that: tsc --typeRoots /opt/node-tools/node_modules/@types
node build.mjs --offline-images --out=$OUT && SITE_DIST=$OUT node tools/check-all.mjs --no-build [--strict-redirects from W1 ia on]
PORT=$PORT SITE_DIST=$OUT node node_modules/playwright/cli.js test --trace off
node tools/a11y.mjs --themes=dark,light --widths=320,1440 --motion=off,on   # once qa lands; until then axe via the global helper
verifierLens: Art director + blueprint auditor: C2 section order, both themes at 5 widths, motion on/off, no-JS
portRule: builder = port; reviewer = port + 10; fixer = port + 20; evidence collector 4400
returns: {branch, head, base, files, gates, acceptance[], requests[]}
requests: .orchestra/requests/t-company.md (never edit a file outside owns; describe the change there)
